title: 第9章 狐宝降世（九）

content_zh:
“娘亲，这些狐狸是宝宝找来的，”白小晨一咬牙，大眼中含着委屈的泪水，“宝宝想要爹爹，你在它们中选一个给宝宝当爹爹好不好？”
众狐狸听到白小晨这话，直接一个踉跄栽倒在地，吓得瑟瑟发抖。
我的祖宗，你能不能不要这么吓人？给你当爹？哪怕有一百个胆子我们也不敢啊。
白颜看到白小晨眼底的泪水，心软了下来，语气也放柔和：“宝宝，不是随便找一只狐狸就能当你爹，必须要他和你娘情投意合才行，可明白？”
见到白颜的怒火消失了，白小晨的眸内划过一道光芒，他用这一套对付娘亲基本是百战百胜，从没失败过。
“娘亲，那我们去找爹爹可好？”白小晨扑到了白颜怀中。
他的身子软软的，小小的，还带着淡淡的奶香味，一点都没有狐狸原本该有的气息。
白颜脸色一僵。
她的脑海里再次浮现出男人危险的眸子，心里下意识的产生一阵抵触。
“嗯，你爹他已经死了。”白颜唔了一声，随意敷衍了一句。
“娘亲，你是不是欺负宝宝读书少，所以骗宝宝？爹爹明明还活着，宝宝能感受得到他的存在。”白小晨撅着小嘴，如粉玉似得小脸因生气而变得通红。
白颜的谎言被识破了，有些尴尬：“这个……其实娘也不知道你爹是谁，但若我们找到了你爹，你爹要是把宝宝从娘亲身边抢走怎么办？”
白小晨沉默了，他还从来没有考虑过这个问题？
爹爹会让他和娘亲分开？
不！不行！他不能离开娘亲！
“娘亲，宝宝不要爹爹了，他是坏蛋，会抢走宝宝。”
白颜缄默不语，如今自己这儿子，已经是她的所有，她绝不会让人从身边抢走他！
若是有人真的敢抢她儿子的话……
她拼死也要杀了他！
流火国。

王府内，某妖孽男打了个喷嚏，满心疑惑，难道有人在背后骂他？
是妖界的那些大臣们？
不管如何，当务之急，还是要找到六年前竟然敢强_奸自己的女人！
一想到自己刚来大陆，守了这么多年的处-男之身就被一个可恶的女人夺走了，他就恨得牙痒痒，若是那女人在他面前，他都有将她碎尸万段的冲动！
竹屋中，白颜已经从软榻上坐了起来，慵懒的伸了个懒腰。
“宝宝，明天我们去找你师公告别，该是时候离开这个地方了。”
五年了……
不知道那些人可还记得她的存在？
白颜眯起双眼，眼底的寒芒微微流转，让她周身的温度都降了几分。
“娘亲，我们要走了吗？”白小晨兴奋的跳了起来，粉雕玉琢的小脸上尽是天真无邪的笑容。
屋内的那些狐狸松了口气，这祖宗终于走了，它们也不用经常担惊受怕了。
“娘亲带你回去找你舅舅，离开五年，也不知道你舅舅可好。”
在白家，她的牵挂只有一个白潇。

content_en:
"Mom, these foxes were found by the baby," Bai Xiaochen gritted his teeth, with tears of grievance in his big eyes, "The baby wants a daddy. Can you choose one of them to be the baby's daddy?"
When the foxes heard Bai Xiaochen's words, they stumbled and fell to the ground, trembling with fear.
My ancestor, can you stop being so scary? Be your father? Even if we had a hundred courages, we wouldn't dare.
When Bai Yan saw the tears in Bai Xiaochen's eyes, her heart softened, and her tone softened: "Baby, you can't just find a fox to be your father. He must be in love with your mother, do you understand?"
Seeing that Bai Yan's anger disappeared, Bai Xiaochen's eyes flashed with light. He used this method to deal with his mother, and he was always victorious and never failed.
"Mom, how about we go find daddy?" Bai Xiaochen threw himself into Bai Yan's arms.
His body was soft, small, and had a faint milky scent, not the scent that a fox should have at all.
Bai Yan's face froze.
The man's dangerous eyes once again appeared in her mind, and she felt a subconscious resistance in her heart.
"Well, your father is dead." Bai Yan said casually and perfunctorily.
"Mom, are you bullying the baby because he doesn't study well, so you lied to the baby? Dad is obviously still alive, and the baby can feel his presence." Bai Xiaochen pouted his little mouth, and his face turned red like pink jade with anger.
Bai Yan's lie was seen through, and she was a little embarrassed: "Well... Actually, mother doesn't know who your father is, but if we find your father, what if your father takes the baby away from mother?"
Bai Xiaochen was silent. He had never considered this issue?
Will his father separate him from his mother?
No! no! He can't leave his mother!
"Mom, the baby doesn't want a father anymore. He is a bad guy and will take the baby away."
Bai Yan remained silent. Now her son was all hers, and she would never let anyone take him away from her!
If someone really dares to steal her son...
She was determined to kill him!
Fire Nation.
In the palace, a certain evil man sneezed and was filled with doubts. Could someone be scolding him behind his back?
Are they the ministers from the demon world?
No matter what, the top priority is to find the woman who dared to rape him six years ago!
When he thought that his virginity, which he had guarded for so many years, was taken away by a hateful woman when he first came to the mainland, he was filled with hatred. If that woman were in front of him, he would have the urge to cut her into pieces!
In the bamboo house, Bai Yan had already sat up from the soft couch and stretched lazily.
"Baby, let's go find your teacher to say goodbye tomorrow. It's time to leave this place."
Five years...
I wonder if those people still remember her existence?
Bai Yan narrowed her eyes, and the cold light in her eyes flowed slightly, causing the temperature around her to drop a bit.
"Mother, are we leaving?" Bai Xiaochen jumped up excitedly, with an innocent smile on his pretty face.
The foxes in the house breathed a sigh of relief. The ancestor was finally gone, and they no longer had to worry so much.
"Mom will take you back to find your uncle. After five years of absence, you still don't know how your uncle is."
In the Bai family, she only cares about Bai Xiao.
